patchFiles.purpose: Reject unconsumed DigestAlgorithm children, non-empty NULL parameters, and non-canonical OID bytes while retaining the pre-existing absent-parameter API.

localExtensions: Empty NULL payload and canonical OID byte checks extend the referenced unmerged candidate; generated-key tests reject both against an independent OpenSSL comparison.

localExtensions: Expansion queues come only from actual child traversal; caller parent cycles, getters and external nested arrays are ignored. This locally fixes a reproduced stack-exhaustion bypass in the referenced candidate. Related design discussion: https://github.com/micromatch/braces/pull/82. Its separate range/expansion-size changes are not imported.

guards.stringFailure: SyntaxError with deliberate input depth message

guards.parentMetadata: Expansion uses queues from actual child traversal. Parent pointers, cyclic or external queues and parent getters are not consulted.
guards.compatibilityChange: Patterns/ASTs beyond100 container levels are intentionally rejected. Callers must handle guard errors.
guards.excludedScope: General regex complexity, cartesian expansion/output size and every malformed/custom object are not proven bounded.

reachability.conclusion: Node development/build dependency. Tested Metro watcher some() matching uses picomatch; direct micromatch parse/braces/braceExpand APIs exercise the patched walker. This is not proof of an exploitable remote application endpoint.
